predictions.rationale: Bootstraps the Identity microservice, registering IdentityServer, ASP.NET Identity, authentication schemes, and token issuing endpoints—core to authentication and service protection.
Defines IdentityServer resources, clients, scopes, and token settings; directly controls how access tokens are issued and validated.
Implements user-facing actions such as login, logout, registration, and account management, mapping exactly to the identity feature.
Contains business logic for authenticating users with Entity Framework stores and creating authentication results for token issuance.
Supplies user claims to IdentityServer during token creation, directly influencing the content of issued access tokens.
Entity Framework context that persists user accounts and related identity data; fundamental for registration and account management.
Represents the user entity within ASP.NET Identity; core model underpinning authentication and account operations.
Handles user consent screens in OAuth flows, an essential part of secure token issuance and scope authorization.
Interface defining the contract for login operations, tying authentication logic to higher-level controllers and services.
Adds JWT bearer tokens to outgoing gateway requests, demonstrating service protection using the issued access tokens.
